Development.AbelianVarietyTheory.BlockTh.text:
- `IsRankRPart` (BS:57) says r_π ⊗ K ≅ ρ ⊕ ⊕_{c=1}^t χ_c. **read**
- `sPi` (BS:71) is the length of a Bloch–Kato Selmer group of ρ ⊗ χ₁⁻¹ with values in (K/O)^r (`selPi`, QH:380). **read**
- It is proved in `NLinkE.main_alt_alt` (TPS/AdmissibleParameterEventually.lean:30) by `congruenceBound_extended_of_rationalBound ∘ globalCongruenceCount_of_rootDifference_unit`. **proved-by**

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Charac.title: Where the proof spends the cohomological bound
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Charac.text:
- `divinN_of_hypV` (`DivinNOfHypV.lean:117`). **proved-by**
  - `vvRecord` (:17) extracts three facts from `HypV`: `ShaFinOdd`, which discharges the premise of `LinkN`; `Summable`, the premise of `LinkN_at`; and Σ'vvTerm ≤ √b.
  - The third is weakened by `Real.sqrt_le_self_iff` to Σ'vvTerm ≤ b.
  - In `divinN_at` (:76), `linarith` closes the goal using hb : Σ' ≤ b together with b ≤ B0 and B0 ≤ x^ε(B0+Nc). So the bound is used, but only in this weaker form.

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Charac.title: What the cohomological length measures
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Charac.text: - `Sha D e` is `Sha1 (qzTw D e)`. These are the classes in H¹(G_S, ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ(−e)) over E that are trivial at every place above ℓ; S is the set of those places. `shaLen` is the ℤ_ℓ-length (`Formalism/GaloisCohomology/Statement.lean:54–78`). **read**

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Charac.title: The two prime choices
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Charac.text: `PairEx` (:28) says: for all M ≥ 1, ε < 1/52 and A ≥ 1 there is Y1 such that every Y ≥ Y1 has q, d with `PairGood M ε Y (Y^A) q d`. **[proved-by]** `QH.pairEx` (`MeanSquareBounds/pairEx.lean:112`).

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Charac.title: The construction behind supplyChi
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Charac.text: **[proved-by]** `supplyChi : ∀ ψ, VWinAt ψ 401 → HostExW (3/2) (GChi ψ).req` (`CharacterBoxes/SupplyChi.lean:8`), proved as `supplyOfAdm` (`CharacterBoxes/HostOfField.lean:17`). That is `supplyOfAdmOf hostOfField` fed with `admissibleClassesTwistedChar` (`CoprimeRanks/AdmChi.lean:13`). The latter gives ranks with `RankVal` and `admitted R H0`: every choice of level data extends H0 to a `Host` (`CharacterBoxes/Imports.lean:9`). **[read]** `hostOfField` (`HostOfField.lean:8`) takes `PairWin s Y`, `PairGood M ε Y x q d`, `FieldRows` and `admitted`. It returns a host H ⊇ H0 satisfying `HostGood s C8 4 c6 Cb H q0` and `Shares H.TT (x^{−1+ε})`. `supplyOfAdmOf` (`ShortNorms/supplyOfAdmOf.lean:13`) combines it with `fieldChi`, `winPairs` (which calls `QH.pairEx`) and `boundedTw`.

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Dedeki.title: The two cases of the pole argument
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Dedeki.text: 4. **[read]** `landau_dichotomy`: given ρ₀ ∈ Z with Re ρ₀ > θ, either (a) B(σ, D), D ≤ σ − θ, is pole-free while some pole has σ − Re ρ₁ < D, or (b) the nearest pole to σ is a real β > θ, alone in B(σ, r), σ − β < r ≤ σ − θ.

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Dedeki.title: Why the argument is windowed
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Dedeki.text: *[inferred]* Only T_k with k → ∞ are used, each seeing g through a kernel centred near u ≈ (1 + δ/2)U, so one window per k, beyond every point, suffices. The off-window mass must fall below σ^{−k} although |g| may reach C₀e^{2u}; tilting achieves this only if the window's log-length δU is proportional to U, and then σ ≈ 36/δ², which blows up as δ → 0. Windows [Y, CY] would fail; any fixed λ > 1 works.

Formalism.HarderNarasimhan.HarderNarasim.title: How the cut rank is bounded
Formalism.HarderNarasimhan.HarderNarasim.text: 2. *Corank share (Markov).* Let x_ij be the normalised HN slopes of N_i minus h_i. **[proved-by]** Their rank-weighted mean is ≥ s, and each is ≤ s + u (by hypothesis and HNExtreme). **[proved-by]** `frameB_share` (HNP/FrameHermSharpB.lean:25) concludes #{x_ij < s − τ} ≤ (Σ m_i)·u/(u+τ). **[proved-by]** Combined with `frameB_count_lt`, this becomes `hcor`. **[proved-by]** It states that the steps Nt(τ,i) = hnStep(N_i, level s−τ+h_i) satisfy Σ_i(rk N_i − rk Nt) ≤ (u/(u+τ))·Σ_i rk N_i. **[proved-by]**

Formalism.HarderNarasimhan.StatementFram.title: Theorem F and its sharper form
Formalism.HarderNarasimhan.StatementFram.text:
**Statement.** `TheoremF` (StatementFrameF.lean:26) and `TheoremFSharp` (:64) have identical hypotheses (third reading §10). **[read]** Their conclusions are

    s - log |I| - (1-δ)⁻¹ * (4u·log(1 + HH/u) + (η + 4√e)·HH) ≤ muDef b' X' cc        -- F
    s           - (1-δ)⁻¹ * (4u·log(1 + HH/u) + (η + 4√e)·HH) ≤ muDef b' X' cc        -- FSharp

Formalism.SharpRestriction.Divisibility..title: The exact integrality statement
Formalism.SharpRestriction.Divisibility..text: - `adm2 D L` (`Formalism/SharpRestriction/Divisibility/LocalQuadraticParts.lean:206`) says: for every word u, place w, φ ∈ `L.NuLat u`, and every F ∈ `Mtilde(muAt w)` that also lies in `V0(muAt w)`, the period `perCol u (muAt w) (jN u φ) F` equals `embLL y` for some y with y = 0 or `⌊ur D w (L.sg u w)⌋ ≤ vAdd (plEq w) y`. **read** `UnroundedValuationBound` (:212) states the same bound without the floor, and `valuation_bound_of_unrounded` (:218) derives `adm2` from it. **read**

Formalism.SizeWindowBrackets.ChainSlopeW.title: Where the two main terms agree
Formalism.SizeWindowBrackets.ChainSlopeW.text: - `key_identity` (`Formalism/RankGapBounds/RankGapProofs/WeightedMeanData.lean:170`) and `key_identity5` (`Formalism/SizeWindowBrackets/ChainSlopeWindows/LevelOfCongruence.lean:105`): SDiv − sumA·Lam5 + m·sumA·lg = Main(u0) + sumA·cCount(La + m²La/k), exactly.
